kill_chain_signals.contact: Fraudsters contact previous victims by phone, email or fax claiming to help recover lost funds
kill_chain_signals.pretext: Impersonate CAFC, law enforcement, government departments, or companies offering refunds; claim to assist with investigation or sting operation
kill_chain_signals.payment: Request advance fees (e.g. $5000 CAD) or Bitcoin deposits (e.g. $1950 CAD) supposedly to support investigation before funds can be returned
kill_chain_signals.movement: Victims asked to sign in to online banking while fraudster has remote access to computer

red_flags: Request for advance fee to obtain a refund
Request for remote access to computer or device
CAFC or police asking you to transfer funds or make payment
Promise to recover previously lost funds
Request to deposit money to support an investigation
key_quote: Remember that the CAFC and police will never ask you to transfer funds or make a payment of any kind.
title: Recovery pitch
